experiment.name: new + say 'can you hear me?'
experiment.result: fast reply at 3.7 s, smart at 4.5 s, both with re = the owner line's at. Real SDK sessions, scratch express port 58741, SERVEX_HOME in the scratchpad. experiment.name: two nav calls
experiment.result: both nav lines in the session file; /framework/ext/ and /framework/ext/Chat/ each got exactly one pointer line in page.jsonl; home got one at /new. Proof files deleted afterwards.
